messages.author: 0490c034b26c6223
messages.subject: methylKit input format
parts:
I currently have genome methylation data for several samples that I want to determine DMRs using methylKit. The methylation data was initially created using Agilent SureSelect Methyl-Seq protocol and Bismark aligner and I have already sorted out the CpGs that had less than 10 sequence coverage and I have aligned the CpG locations so that each sample that I want to use in the methylKit pipeline represents the same CpGs at the same locations. I would like to feed these files into methylKit. The format is as follows:

Chromosome   Location  Percent_Methylation
chr1  1023456   50
chr2  3542765   25
etc.

Can this format and the presence of a calculated percent methylation be uploaded and used in methylKit.
How would this be done?. Thanks

Dave

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] methylKit input format
parts:
You need the additional read counts column to be able to calculate and read the methylation information. If you used sure sureSelect you must have the read counts per CpG or per region somewhere in your pipeline. You should be able to read generic tabular text files with read() function. There are examples of how to read such files in the blog (linked at the methylKit webpage)

best,
Altuna
